U3: which FROM sources a join condition (`ПО`) sees when the FROM list has several roots separated by commas.
verdict: A join condition sees only its own join chain: a qualified or bare reference to another comma root is `Field not found`, whether that root is listed before or after the chain; a bare name present in the own chain and in another root binds to the own chain.
